title: MK Monarch acknowledged

tellings.quote:
My friend Emma has a show called
Imagination Podcast that was on YouTube
about MK Monarch, which link I sent you
has been acknowledged.

plain: Kurt Metzger, a comedian, says on podcast host Jesse Michels' show that his friend Emma made a YouTube show called Imagination Podcast about MK Monarch, a name he uses for an alleged secret mind-control programme. Metzger says that MK Monarch has been acknowledged, and he says he sent the host a link about it. If so, it would mean a programme many dismiss had been officially admitted.
